Threat Actor or Source: release storage operator attacker deleting or replacing signatures or signing service omitting an audit record
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: a valid signature is unavailable mutable attached to another statement or lacks the required auditable issuance receipt
Why This Check Is Required: generation without durable exact publication cannot be consumed or audited and may silently downgrade at the release boundary
Required State: exact statement and signature digests at a versioned HTTPS location with transparency inclusion
Verification Method: make verify-control CONTROL=PSB-REL-005 and probe live immutable publication
Expected Result: HTTP latest mutable missing mismatched or non-transparent publication evidence is rejected
Required Evidence: sanitized ASG-006 decision; publication and transparency receipt metadata
Framework Mappings: nist-ssdf 1.1 (SP 800-218, 2022) / PS.2.1 / supports / high; openssf-osps-baseline 2026.02.19 / OSPS-BR-06.01 / evidence-for / high
Limitations: Offline fixtures and the local ephemeral-key harness do not prove live KMS HSM keyless OIDC transparency publication or key-custody adoption.; The committed transparency receipt is synthetic and cannot substitute for an authenticated live log proof and trusted root.; The offline contract binds a nonce but does not prove issuer-side atomic nonce uniqueness or replay-ledger durability.; A compromised authorized signer or release workflow can create internally consistent malicious signatures.; Artifact signing does not replace provenance generation distribution consumer verification SBOM vulnerability testing or two-person release governance.; This control is not a SLSA Build level requirement and does not establish framework product or release compliance.
